intent: Test ordinary Web extraction independently before expanding support to documents, repositories, videos, or more X-specific work.

A rendered-source comparison of 18 varied pages found native snapshots clean and source-faithful; both Jina recoveries retained complete content but included more navigation and cookie/footer material. The focused artifact-fetch suite passes 16 tests, including the new resurrected-redirect regression.
impact_next: Use ordinary Web snapshots as the first artifact input to audience insight experiments. Prefer native text, treat Jina as a complete but noisier availability fallback, reject sub-1,000-character interactive shells as weak evidence, and continue source classes one at a time rather than crawling the full catalog.

title: Audience routing v3 retained short evidence and isolated an Azure cache regression

evidence: The 8,188-character/1,180-word v3 prefix needs no padding and the previously lost Grok claim is now present. Thirteen focused tests pass. One Azure deployment received the prompt_cache_key, prompt_cache_retention=24h, instructions, and schema unchanged with no retry or fallback, isolating the regression upstream.
impact_next: Keep the shared adapter, stable cache-first prompt layout, 32 deterministic lanes, and cache telemetry; do not pad the prompt or claim variable-input savings until Azure returns nonzero cached_tokens. Review the v3 reasons before routing a third distinct envelope.
tools_spend: Five Luna-medium requests reached Azure for $0.016208 persisted LiteLLM spend; one additional exact repeat was served by LiteLLM Redis at $0. The diagnostic otherwise used read-only proxy inspection and local tests.
